components.name: Framework dependency packaging
components.gap: `pk_core` is required by normal imports and conformance/gate execution but is not bundled or declared in a package/dependency manifest; the framework test suite therefore skips in this isolated archive.
components.required_completion: Add pyproject.toml/lock or workspace manifest with a pinned pk_core source/version; make CI fail if pk_core conformance cannot execute.

components.name: Python package/release metadata
components.gap: No pyproject.toml/setup metadata, Python compatibility declaration, dependency constraints, build backend, wheel/sdist path, or reproducible environment lock.
components.required_completion: Add PEP 517 metadata, supported Python range, pinned dependencies/hashes, reproducible build and install smoke tests.

components.name: Versioned typed interface schemas
components.gap: PK_LOCAL_CHAIN/1, PK_RESIDENCY/1, and PK_CHAIN_DEPTH/1 are named in prose but have no machine-readable schema/WIT/IDL definitions or schema conformance tests.
components.required_completion: Add versioned schema files for requests, responses, errors, residency records and depth context; test backward/forward compatibility.

components.name: Authoritative capability-provider integration
components.gap: 4.2 adds a per-hop capability hook, but no authoritative policy/capability provider is wired, versioned, or failover-tested. The compatibility fallback is not equivalent to external capability policy.
components.required_completion: Define the capability decision contract, inject the system authority in production, specify fail-closed outage behavior, and add integration/security tests.

components.name: Authentication and caller identity model
components.gap: Tenant and trace identifiers are caller-supplied strings; there is no authenticated principal, attestation, credential binding, or identity provenance on a local hop.
components.required_completion: Introduce authenticated call context derived from trusted runtime identity, not request-controlled strings; define attestation/outage semantics.

components.name: Production remote-transport adapter
components.gap: 4.2 can inject `remote_dispatch`, but no concrete adapter to the repository's network transport exists and default behavior still returns a compatibility sentinel tuple.
components.required_completion: Implement/test the adjacent transport adapter, network-unavailable behavior, deadlines, error mapping, and semantic parity with local calls.

components.name: Async/await chaining path
components.gap: The contract depends on INV-16 Async component functions, but `Chainer.call()` and handlers are synchronous and do not await async handlers or remote dispatchers.
components.required_completion: Add `call_async`/async handler support with cancellation and context propagation; define sync/async interop and tests.

components.name: Deadlines, cancellation, retry, idempotency and backpressure
components.gap: No deadline/cancellation token, bounded retry policy, idempotency key semantics, queue/backpressure mechanism, or retry safety classification exists.
components.required_completion: Define hop deadline/cancellation propagation, idempotency metadata, retry policy with backoff/jitter, and bounded queues/admission.

components.name: Admission control and circuit breaking
components.gap: Depth and telemetry are bounded, but concurrent calls, per-tenant quotas, fan-out, handler saturation and remote failures have no admission/load-shedding/circuit-breaker controls.
components.required_completion: Add configurable concurrency/tenant limits, saturation signals, load shedding and circuit breaker state with deterministic tests.

components.name: Residency freshness/lease/watch protocol
components.gap: Residency is authoritative but has no TTL/lease, epoch/source provenance, watcher synchronization, stale-entry detection, duplicate-owner arbitration, or reconciliation protocol.
components.required_completion: Add generation/lease metadata, atomic snapshots, stale detection, ownership rules and reconciliation tests against the placement/control plane.

components.name: Lifecycle and state-transition model
components.gap: No explicit initializing/ready/degraded/quarantined/stopped lifecycle or legal transition table exists for the chainer/residency state.
components.required_completion: Define states, transition guards, restart/recovery semantics and machine-verifiable transition tests.

components.name: Declarative configuration schema
components.gap: Runtime knobs exist only as constructor arguments; there is no declarative config schema for depth, telemetry, policy provider, transport, quotas, or site/environment overrides.
components.required_completion: Add versioned config schema with secure defaults, validation, environment overlays and activation tests.

components.name: Configuration provenance and atomic activation
components.gap: No author/source/version/activation timestamp is recorded for configuration, and there is no transactional config activation or rollback snapshot.
components.required_completion: Add immutable config revisions, provenance, validate-before-swap activation and previous-revision rollback.

components.name: Ownership, escalation and ADR artifacts
components.gap: No CODEOWNERS/owner record, escalation path, architecture decision record, or incident contact metadata is present.
components.required_completion: Add OWNER/CODEOWNERS, ADR for direct composition/local fallback policy, and escalation/runbook ownership.

components.name: Requirements traceability matrix
components.gap: The 100-item checklist and master prompts exist, but there is no persisted matrix mapping each item to code/config/test/evidence and release acceptance status.
components.required_completion: Add machine-readable traceability matrix with evidence paths/hashes and gate status per C001-C100.

components.name: Supported-version compatibility matrix
components.gap: No matrix states supported local-chain schema versions, pk_core version, Python versions, adjacent component versions or downgrade behavior.
components.required_completion: Add compatibility matrix and automated N/N-1 (and documented N+1 where relevant) tests.

components.name: Artifact provenance, SBOM and signature verification
components.gap: No SBOM, dependency hashes, provenance attestation, signed release manifest, artifact digest verification, or vulnerability scan policy exists.
components.required_completion: Generate SBOM/provenance, pin hashes, sign release artifacts, verify on bootstrap, and define vulnerability response SLAs.

components.name: Tamper-evident security audit stream
components.gap: `DecisionEvent` is bounded in-process telemetry only; it is mutable runtime state, not a tamper-evident durable audit trail correlated with release/infrastructure lineage.
components.required_completion: Export security-sensitive decisions to an append-only signed/chained audit sink with stable IDs and release/topology correlation.

components.name: Telemetry export, health/readiness and dependency status
components.gap: Counters and decision records are in-memory only; there is no health/readiness surface, metrics exporter, structured log sink, dependency status, active capability report, or resource telemetry.
components.required_completion: Add health/readiness snapshot and OpenTelemetry/metrics/log adapters with stable labels and bounded cardinality.

components.name: Telemetry privacy, retention, sampling and explain view
components.gap: Decision reasons are recorded, but no privacy/redaction policy, retention/sampling/export rules, or operator-facing explain view exists.
components.required_completion: Define redaction/cardinality policy, retention/sampling configuration, and an explain API/view linking decisions to policy/topology inputs.

components.name: Dashboards and alerting
components.gap: No dashboards, SLO alerts, policy-rejection alerts, saturation alerts, dependency-failure alerts, or attack/defect discrimination rules are included.
components.required_completion: Add dashboard/alert definitions with tested thresholds and runbook links.

components.name: Reproducible benchmark suite and performance evidence
components.gap: The README states a p99 <20us SLO, but there are no benchmark harnesses, baseline artifacts, percentile distributions, overload/recovery runs, tenant overhead, power/thermal measurements, or regression gate.
components.required_completion: Add reproducible micro/macro benchmarks, p50/p95/p99/worst thresholds, edge power runs, and CI regression gates.

components.name: Capacity model and saturation signals
components.gap: No capacity formula/model covers concurrent chains, handler fan-out, per-tenant fairness, remote handoff pressure, CPU/memory limits, or saturation thresholds.
components.required_completion: Document and implement capacity ceilings, fairness rules, saturation metrics and sizing tests.

components.name: Serialization/zero-copy measurement evidence
components.gap: Direct handler composition avoids a network hop, but the repository does not measure serialization/copy/context-switch savings or prove zero-copy safety/semantics.
components.required_completion: Add comparative local-vs-remote profiling and correctness tests for any zero-copy/argument-handoff optimization.

components.name: Fuzz/property tests for untrusted inputs
components.gap: No fuzzing/property tests cover callee/tenant/trace/path values, handler failures, policy decisions, schema boundaries, or hostile oversized inputs.
components.required_completion: Add Hypothesis/Atheris or equivalent fuzz/property suite with corpus and CI budget.

components.name: Concurrency/race test suite
components.gap: Residency was made thread-safe, but there are no race tests for concurrent place/unplace/resolve/call, revision monotonicity, or policy/transport callback concurrency.
components.required_completion: Add multi-thread stress/race tests and, where supported, sanitizer/instrumented runs.

components.name: Threat-model-derived adversarial tests
components.gap: Current tests cover cross-tenant and capability refusal only; no replay/spoofing/injection/resource-exhaustion/side-channel/provider-compromise scenarios are exercised.
components.required_completion: Create threat model artifact and automated negative tests for each abuse case, including spoofed identity/trace, handler exceptions and exhaustion.

components.name: Adjacent-layer integration tests
components.gap: No executable integration suite proves interoperability with INV-20, INV-10, INV-16, INV-13 or SCH-01; the pk_core conformance test skips when the framework is absent.
components.required_completion: Create workspace integration fixtures for each declared dependency and make skipped mandatory integration tests a CI failure.

components.name: Platform/runtime compatibility tests
components.gap: No test matrix covers supported Python versions, CPU architectures, operating systems/runtimes, protocol versions or execution tiers.
components.required_completion: Declare supported matrix and run CI on representative Windows/Linux and target architectures/runtimes.

components.name: Fault-injection, partition and reconnect testing
components.gap: No tests inject handler crash/stall, policy-provider outage, stale residency, remote transport failure, node/site partition, reconnect, or degraded control plane.
components.required_completion: Add deterministic failure injection and recovery objective assertions.

components.name: Health/stall detection and quarantine control
components.gap: No handler stall thresholds, watchdogs, unhealthy placement suppression, quarantine/freeze control, or runtime emergency-disable switch exists.
components.required_completion: Add deadline/stall detection, quarantine state, disable switch and operator recovery path.

components.name: Crash consistency / restart / reconstruction procedure
components.gap: Residency state is memory-only with no explicit reconstruction source, startup reconciliation, snapshot/restore boundary, or restart invariant tests.
components.required_completion: Document authoritative reconstruction from placement source and test clean restart/reconciliation; explicitly mark backup N/A if derived state.

components.name: Canary/staged rollout and automated rollback
components.gap: README mentions rerunning gates and removing a registry component, but no canary/staged rollout mechanism, rollback automation, rollback criteria, or versioned migration procedure is supplied.
components.required_completion: Add rollout/rollback runbook and automation hooks with health/SLO abort criteria.

components.name: Patching, vulnerability and EOL policy
components.gap: No supported-version lifecycle, security patch SLA, CVE intake process, EOL timeline, or dependency update policy exists.
components.required_completion: Add SECURITY.md/support policy with response targets and release lifecycle.

components.name: Incident severity and response runbook
components.gap: No severity taxonomy, paging triggers, containment steps, evidence collection, recovery validation, or escalation workflow exists.
components.required_completion: Add incident runbook tied to local-chain failure/security signals.

components.name: Recurring review and exception/waiver registry
components.gap: No scheduled architecture/access/policy/dependency review record or owned exception/waiver/technical-debt registry with expiry exists.
components.required_completion: Add review cadence/checklist and machine-readable waiver/debt ledger with owner and expiry.

components.name: Formal production exit evidence bundle
components.gap: No generated evidence ledger/gate result is present in the archive, and normal gate execution cannot run without pk_core. Therefore production exit cannot be independently verified from this repository alone.
components.required_completion: Bundle signed machine-readable gate results, evidence ledger, hashes and release manifest produced in CI with all mandatory checks non-skipped.

components.name: Continuous integration workflow
components.gap: No CI configuration runs compile, runtime tests, full pk_core conformance, security checks, compatibility tests, benchmarks or packaging validation on change.
components.required_completion: Add CI pipeline with fail-on-skip mandatory gates, test artifacts and release evidence.

components.name: License and notice files
components.gap: The archive contains no LICENSE/NOTICE file or explicit redistribution terms for the implementation package.
components.required_completion: Add the project-approved license and notice/provenance metadata.

components.name: Structured request/call context
components.gap: Caller identity, tenant, trace, deadline, capabilities and operation metadata are separate primitive arguments rather than a validated/versioned context object, increasing spoofing and compatibility risk.
components.required_completion: Define immutable typed CallContext with authenticated principal, tenant, trace/span, deadline, idempotency and capability claims/proofs.

components.name: Handler exception and failure-code normalization
components.gap: Chain-internal refusal errors are structured, but arbitrary local handler exceptions and remote adapter failures pass through without a stable error taxonomy or local/remote semantic normalization.
components.required_completion: Define error envelope/mapping rules and parity tests across local and remote paths.

components.name: Semantic-equivalence test suite
components.gap: The core promise that local and remote calls are semantically identical is asserted in prose but not tested against the same request corpus, errors, cancellation, authz, serialization and edge cases.
components.required_completion: Build a shared conformance corpus executed through both local and remote paths and byte/semantic-compare outcomes.
